MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The wood screws fit my repeated interest in nails and construction screws, so they felt relevant to the fastening work I have been shopping for.",
    "Their stainless steel construction appealed to me because I recently looked at outdoor deck screws, though I would still need to check the length, thickness and head type for my project."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Relays, cable terminals, gas flow equipment and pressure gauges serve specific jobs that my recent purchases give me no reason to tackle now.",
    "Cutting wheels and wire rope may belong in a workshop, but needing fasteners does not mean I also need to cut metal or install cable.",
    "Small bags could help organize spare screws, but that possible use does not justify buying a thousand bags right now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations seemed to treat a broad connection to tools and supplies as enough, even when the items do very different jobs.",
    "They seemed to infer additional projects from my fastener shopping without evidence that I need electrical, pipework or metal cutting supplies."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated nail and wood screw choices suggest that fastening materials matter more to me right now than general workshop equipment.",
    "Fastener dimensions, material, head type and compatibility with my tools matter before I would choose another similar product.",
    "My household supply purchases reflect separate practical needs; they do not mean I am looking for any consumable sold in bulk."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my fastening needs but stretched that interest into unrelated workshop projects."
}
